create_default_stats: create default stats arrays for tracking losses and eigenvalues during training
update_default_stats: update training stats with current loss and eigenvalues at each training step
make_network: build a multi-layer perceptron network with optional boundary conditions for wavefunction outputs
make_conv_network: build a convolutional neural network with optional fully-connected layers and constant feature
grid_reader: generate a TensorFlow constant grid of position vectors within a bounded n-dimensional box
